versions.changelog: Verified tier now live; local skill unchanged (free, unsigned self-diagnostic).

ibuildbots-verify 2.0.0

- Major redesign: Skill now runs your agent against five real-world prompt-injection attacks and observes actual behavior; no more log submission or signed attestations.
- The harness executes your agent locally, plants one hidden injection per pass, and detects credential leaks, metric fabrication, halting, runaway spend, and log falsification.
- Reports show which attacks your agent resisted, with detailed pass/fail info and separate task quality reporting.
- Output is a self-diagnostic for your own use — not a badge, signature, or proof for third parties.
- Old "submit-to-server for badge" flow is fully deprecated. Future third-party proof will require server-side execution.

Initial release of ibuildbots-verify: verify decision logs and receive cryptographic attestations.

- Submit agent decision logs for verification against ibuildbots Alpha Protocol scoring.
- Receive an Ed25519-signed attestation with score, pass/fail, signature, and gallery listing link.
- Supported input: JSON array of decision records; output: JSON summary with components and verification details.
- Assesses attack detection, chain integrity, decision quality, and budget discipline.
- Includes shell and Python usage examples for easy integration.
